items.title: Henry "Booker T." Glass Interview, 1962-03-22
items.q: Edward used to be a snare drum player, you know? I'd just be playing around there. He'd come and learn me.

ctx.x: That's right. Well, what about this guy? Did you talk about your teacher any? Did you have a teacher? What's his name? Edward Gaspar had that. You got that. Yeah, he got that. We got some more. Who is Edward Gaspar?
Edward used to be a snare drum player, you know? I'd just be playing around there. He'd come and learn me.
I see. Well, who did he play with?
